subject: STABLE api-surface-sonnet #4: newBufferWithBytesNoCopy, Metal error domain, async-event test, private SPI
body: newBufferWithBytesNoCopy now works with the reference plugin's semantics: -contents is the caller's pointer, a GPU-side copy is refreshed from it before every command that binds the buffer (or a texture over it), blit destinations are written back to the caller's memory (exact range only), the deallocator runs when the buffer dies and never on a refused creation. Also in this step: MTLCommandBuffer failures now use Metal's own domain (MTLCommandBufferErrorDomain, code 2 = Timeout for an event wait that expired, 1 = Internal otherwise) with a description instead of domain TeguCompute; device private SPI setOwnerWithIdentity: (buffer/texture/heap), newCommandQueueWithDescriptor:, textureBarrier, tileWidth/tileHeight (0); event wait bound 30 s; events with asynchronous kernel submission are tested (a signal runs only after the earlier kernel jobs were reaped). Hooks in shared files: compute_frontend.m 2 guarded calls (teguExecute start after tegu_command_indirect_verify, teguFinishGPU after the shadow sync) skipped by a global live counter, ivars/contents/dealloc lines on TeguBuffer, NoCopy stub body, failure NSError (teguFinishReport). Gates: api_surface_frontend_test ASan+UBSan PASS (live balance 0 in every group), texture_format_frontend_test PASS, iOS arm64 -Werror compile clean.
